messages.content: Who are in the cricket matches scheduled for today?

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who are in the cricket matches scheduled for today?" We need to retrieve the schedule for today's date. Use the function sports_analyzer_get_schedule with date set to today's date. The default sport is cricket; we can leave sport unspecified or set it to cricket. Country default is USA but we might want all countries. The question didn't specify a country, so we should probably include all countries. So call the function with date=YYYY-MM-DD (today's date). Today is 2026-07-09. So date="2026-07-09". Sport="cricket" (default). Country omitted.

We then parse the response. The function returns a JSON array of match objects. Each object has fields: id, name, start_time, end_time, venue, teams, status, score, etc. We need to extract the teams participating in each match. Then produce a list of unique team names. Format as bullet points. If no matches, say none.
